entities.name: lead tracker at the head of the file
entities.what: Tracker (hired labourer) in a light short jacket and trousers with a small round cap or topknot, at the west head of the file: he walks west, leaning a little forward, his near arm bent up in front of his face (holding the rope's end or its strap at his shoulder, or wiping his brow); the end of the tow rope (river_m's, part of 逆水行舟; S2.grp.boat_towed_mast_23632' note has its painted line on this stretch) is at his hands at the waist.
entities.src: 名画记: 逆水行舟 (pin 15); Hansen plates 10-12 (the trackers); 张安治: the five trackers
entities.note: Head u 21848-21862, v 150-163; the bent arm is a loop at u 21828-21852, v 160-193; front (west) foot (21852, 230), rear (east) foot (21882, 240); foot = midway. Painted height 85 px at foot v 235. The rope's west end is at his hands, about (21832, 197). The restyle gives him a pole with hooks reaching west to u ~21790 (v ~165): the scan has no pole there, only the bank's ink wash at u 21800-21810, v 157-163. Crops: scratchpad S2_t2/insp_A.jpg, trk_ab.jpg.

entities.name: second tracker, bent far forward
entities.what: Tracker in light short clothes and a small hat, bent far forward toward the west, his back almost level, both hands low on the tow rope (river_m's, part of 逆水行舟; S2.grp.boat_towed_mast_23632' note has its painted line on this stretch) at his waist; front leg forward, rear leg pushing off.
entities.src: 名画记: 逆水行舟 (pin 15); Hansen plates 10-12 (the trackers); 张安治: the five trackers
entities.note: Head (with hat) u 21912-21928, v 178-190, lowest point of his body line; his back rises east to u 21935-21960, v 187-212; front foot (21925, 253), rear foot (21953, 262). Painted height 80 px (bent; about 90 px if upright) at foot v 258. The restyle adds a half-hidden man with a grey sack just behind him (u 21900-21930, v 173-220): the scan has only this man's hat and rounded back.

entities.name: third tracker in a hatched (straw?) cape
entities.what: Tracker whose back and shoulders are drawn with dense short hatching, a straw rain cape (蓑衣) or a dark rough jacket, over trousers; small cap; leaning west in mid-stride and hauling on the tow rope (river_m's, part of 逆水行舟; S2.grp.boat_towed_mast_23632' note has its painted line on this stretch), which crosses his body at the waist.
entities.src: 名画记: 逆水行舟 (pin 15); Hansen plates 10-12 (the trackers); 张安治: the five trackers
entities.note: Hatched body u 21965-22002, v 198-252; head u 21975-21992, v 199-215; front foot (21978, 277), rear foot (22010, 287). Painted height 83 px at foot v 282. The garment is the uncertain part (conf of the figure is high): straw cape or dark cloth; the restyle paints a dark blue jacket. Crop: S2_t2/insp_C.jpg, trk_cd.jpg.

entities.name: fourth tracker in a broad hat, hunched
entities.what: Tracker in a broad round hat, hunched forward toward the west with a rounded back (a bundle carried on his back, or only his bent back), the tow rope (river_m's, part of 逆水行舟; S2.grp.boat_towed_mast_23632' note has its painted line on this stretch) at his waist; mid-stride.
entities.src: 名画记: 逆水行舟 (pin 15); Hansen plates 10-12 (the trackers); 张安治: the five trackers
entities.note: Hat brim u 22020-22057, v 232-242; face under it u 22033-22047, v 248-265; the rounded back or bundle u 22050-22073, v 242-275; front foot (22035, 305), rear foot (22078, 325). Painted height 84 px at foot v 315. The restyle splits this mass into TWO men (one in a white headband in front, one in a black cap with a brown pack behind; heads at u ~22031 and ~22046): the scan has one head under one hat and one pair of legs, so one man, which also gives 张安治's count of five. If a second-pass reader finds a second head here, the bundle is the place to look. Crops: S2_t2/insp_D.jpg, trk_cd.jpg.

entities.name: rear tracker hauling 逆水行舟's tow rope
entities.what: Tracker (hired labourer) in a short jacket belted at the waist, trousers and a round cloth cap; the last (easternmost) of the five, leaning a little forward to the west in mid-stride, both hands gripping the tow rope (river_m's, part of 逆水行舟; S2.grp.boat_towed_mast_23632' note has its painted line on this stretch) in front of him at the waist; behind him the rope runs on east-south-east down the bank toward the water.
entities.src: 名画记: 逆水行舟 (pin 15); Hansen plates 10-12 (the trackers); 张安治: the five trackers
entities.note: Head u 22146-22162, v 293-300; hands on the rope at about (22163, 337); front (west) foot lifted at (22150, 371), rear foot planted at (22194, 393); foot = midway between the planted foot and the ground under the lifted one. Painted height 93 px at foot v 386. SEAM t2|t3: the main point (u 22172) is past t2's range end (22100), but the brief gives all five trackers to t2. t3 recorded him too under this same ID (t3: foot (22173, 392), head (22151, 293)); the merge keeps the first file's entity (t2.json). The restyle adds a walker just east of him (u ~22200-22300): not painted. Merge: t3 recorded the same man under this ID (foot (22173, 392), head (22151, 293), rear foot planted at (22193, 396), painted 99 px bent, about 105-110 px upright); t3's copy was dropped. t3 read the rope entering his hands at about (22165, 335) and on east (22180, 345), (22250, 375), (22350, 410), (22450, 432), (22520, 447), (22650, 460), (22800, 480), (22950, 500).

entities.name: man in a long robe on the north-bank strip
entities.what: Man in a light long robe and a dark cap standing on the narrow strip of bank between the shops and the moored cabin boat, seen three-quarters from behind, turned toward the smaller figure just east of him as if talking.
entities.note: Head u 21523-21533, v 73-83; feet u 21525-21539, v 142-147. Painted height 73 px at foot v 146. Facing is a reading (back to us, head turned west-north-west); the restyle shows him three-quarter to the west. Crops: S2_t2/insp_men12.jpg, top_men.jpg.

entities.name: smaller figure beside him (boy or man further back)
entities.what: A smaller figure in a light robe standing just north-east of the robed man, facing the viewer with the hands together in front: a boy, or a man standing a little further back; the two seem to talk.
entities.note: Faint lines u 21542-21558, v 78-123: a head at (21543-21553, 78-90) and a body down to about v 120-125; foot est at v ~124. Painted height ~46 px against his companion's 73 px at foot v 146: either a child (about 0.65 of the man) or an adult standing further north. The restyle paints a man in a yellow robe facing us, feet at v ~125-130.

entities.name: two people talking on the north-bank strip
entities.what: On the narrow strip of bank in front of the shops, a man in a long robe stands with a smaller figure beside him, as if talking.

entities.name: faint seated figure inside the open shop
entities.what: A faint figure seated behind a table or counter inside the open front of the shop at the top of the silk (shopkeeper or customer).
entities.note: Rounded shape u 21662-21698, v 60-96 between the shop's front posts, above the sill line (v ~97-107). Very faint at zoom 3-5; the restyle paints a man in white seated behind a table with a jar. OTHER READING: shop goods or furniture only. The shop is structures_w's. Crops: S2_t2/shop_z2.jpg, insp_shop.jpg.

entities.name: faint standing figure (or post) at the shop's east bay
entities.what: A small upright shape at the east bay of the same open shop, read as a person standing inside (or a post or tall jar).
entities.note: Shape u 21718-21734, v 68-100 with a rounded top at (21722-21730, 68-76). The restyle has a pillar and a jar here, no person. Readings: a person (painted 33 px, small for v 101), a post of the shop front (structures_w's) or a tall jar (a prop).

entities.name: table or counter inside the open shop
entities.what: Faint horizontal top of a table or counter inside the open shop front, behind which the seated figure sits.
entities.note: Top u 21662-21702, v ~80-96, just above the sill (v ~97-107). May be the building's sill or a shelf (structures_w's).

entities.name: the open shop at the top of the silk
entities.what: Inside the open front of a shop at the top of the silk, a figure sits behind a table or counter and another stands at the east bay (both faint).
entities.note: The shop (roof v 15-45, front posts v 45-110, u ~21530-21770) is structures_w's.

entities.name: the great pollarded willow on the south bank
entities.what: Huge old pollarded willow on the south bank: a massive, knobbed, hollow-looking trunk about 150-200 px wide rising from just above the south-bank roofs and leaning north; at about v 960-1000 it forks into a tall upright stem that carries the crown's top and a heavy eastern limb; long thin whips without leaf masses (early spring) droop from both, the eastern ones sweeping far out over the water to about u 22090. Single trunk.
entities.vis: part: the trunk's foot meets the thatched south-bank roof's ridge (v ~1450-1470); the crown's west edge mixes with the t1 trees' whips
entities.note: Trunk: foot u ~21290-21400 at v 1440-1452 (just above the thatched roof, structures_w's), dark knobbed mass u 21275-21430 at v 1220-1400, up to the fork at about (21310-21490, 960-1000). Upright stem u 21270-21320 from v ~960 to the top twig (21305, 312). Eastern limb from (21470-21550, 1010-1090), its whips to (22090, 1110) and up to (21707, 536). Crown extents u ~20980-22090, v 312-1180; crown_w is uncertain (whips at u 20950-21100, v 600-960 may be the t1 trees'). Base est because the foot is hidden where it meets the roof's ridge. Main point u 21345 is 45 px inside t2's range (t1's ends at 21300). The restyle shows figures climbing in the trunk's knobs at u ~21490-21545, v 1160-1245: only knobs are painted. The small dark mark at (21357, 1364) on the trunk is a knob, not a bird. Crops: S2_t2/willow_whole.jpg, insp_willow.jpg, insp_wfoot.jpg, crown_top.jpg.

entities.name: small dark bird (?) perched in the great willow's whips
entities.what: A small solid dark blot among the great willow's eastern whips high over the water, a smaller round top over a larger body, like a small bird perched upright on a whip.
entities.note: Blot u 21722-21738, v 614-636 (about 16 x 22 px): an upper smaller dot (21722-21728, 614-620) and a body (21725-21738, 625-636); solid ink, unlike the whips' line work. Readings: a perched bird (sparrow or crow size) or an ink blot/knot. The restyle doesn't show it. Crops: S2_t2/bird_z8.jpg, insp_bird.jpg.

entities.name: small shrub on the south-bank mound's crest
entities.what: A small branching shrub or bush at the west end of the south-bank mound's crest, where the crest's dark band of low growth begins.
entities.note: Sprigs u 21590-21620, v 1392-1417. The dark wash along the crest east of it (u 21630-21810, v 1398-1420) is low growth on the mound (the ground feature's, left to structures_w). The setup look listed a tiny figure here: it is this sprig. The restyle draws a small bush.

entities.name: big man in a broad hat at the south bank's edge
entities.what: Big figure in a broad dark round hat with a hanging tie and a light jacket, seated (or squatting) at the edge of the south bank right at the bow of a small boat coming in from the silk's bottom edge, leaning forward to the west, his face in profile, both arms reaching down in front of him (to a rope, a plank or the boat's stem); a boatman or a porter.
entities.vis: part: below the hips hidden at the bank's edge and the boat's bow
entities.note: Hat u 21987-22077, v 1570-1610; face (profile, west) u 21990-22007, v 1613-1653; the hat's tie u 22053-22060, v 1627-1667; body u 21990-22095 down to v ~1700-1705; arms to (21973-22023, 1673-1687). A long diagonal line runs under him from (21890, 1673) to (22127, 1733): the far edge of the south bank's flat top (the restyle's reading) or the gunwale of the small boat. The boat's bow post is at u 22127-22157, v 1710-1780, its hull curving off the silk's bottom edge (u 22017-22160, v 1737-1790; river_w2's). READINGS: (1, taken) he sits on the bank's edge beside the boat's bow (restyle: seated on the bank with his back to us); (2) he stands in the small boat's bow behind its gunwale, his legs hidden (then river_w2's, support 'boat deck: <id>'). Painted head-to-seat ~135 px, the biggest figure in t2's range (near the viewer). Crops: S2_t2/big_z3.jpg, insp_big.jpg, insp_south_wide.jpg, ov_se.jpg. Second pass (west): he is seen from behind: the hat's tie hangs down the middle of his back (22053-22060, 1627-1667), the back of his light jacket faces the viewer, and only a sliver of his profile shows at the hat's west edge (21990-22007, 1613-1653); his arms reach down in front of him to the west (21973-22023, 1673-1687). So he faces north-west, away from the viewer (135), not straight west (180). On the bank, as t2 read him: the small boat's near gunwale curves up from (22020, 1790) to its bow post (22127-22157, 1705-1780) south of his seat line (21890, 1673)-(22127, 1733), so he sits on the bank's edge above the boat, not inside it. Crops: z_bighat.jpg, i_bighat.jpg.

entities.name: timber on a post at the south bank (wooden frame)
entities.what: A squared timber with a cross-piece at its upper (east) end, slanting up to the east from a short upright post, standing on the south bank just east of the thatched roof's edge: a trestle or prop of some kind (perhaps for a boat or a pole).
entities.vis: part: its foot at the bank's diagonal edge line
entities.note: Beam (21895, 1602) -> (21983, 1557) with a cross-piece at u 21970-21990, v 1555-1565; upright post u 21907-21935, v 1597-1663; foot est at the ground line (v ~1660-1670). The restyle draws a wooden contraption (a windlass support or a sawhorse). Alternatively a timber of the south-bank building's gable sticking out (structures_w's).

entities.name: crouching man (?) under the timber at the thatched roof's edge
entities.what: A dark round head and a hunched body under the west end of the slanting timber, at the edge of the thatched roof: read as a man crouching with the timber's end on or at his shoulder.
entities.note: Dark rounded shape (head with dark hair or cap) u 21865-21888, v 1591-1615; faint body lines u 21870-21895, v 1615-1660 down to the ground line (v ~1655-1665). Painted 71 px (crouching). READINGS: (1) a man crouching under or shouldering the timber (the restyle paints a man in a green cap crouched there; sections/canal/notes.md says the restyle makes a man shouldering a beam out of a wooden object); (2) a dark knot of the thatch roof's edge tufts with the timber's post. Kept at conf low so the second pass can settle it. Crops: S2_t2/beam_z4.jpg, insp_beam.jpg.

entities.name: the timber and the crouching man
entities.what: At the south bank's edge, by the thatched roof, a man (faint) crouches under the west end of a timber slanting up on a post.
